answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Work waits on the basalt until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the signal of the next round. The design leans on invitation quota tree, taxed when attestations come from one subnet. What survives to the karst is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
